dict.string: DropNotch uses this to show what's playing in Music and Spotify and to send play, pause, skip and seek from the notch. If you're using DropNotch's Terminal tab, a command you ran there may be the one asking: commands there use DropNotch's access.

DropNotch shows your upcoming events on the Home tab; the Calendar card only reads them. Commands you run in DropNotch's Terminal tab get this access too, and they can add, change or delete events. Nothing leaves your Mac unless a command you run sends it.
DropNotch uses this to keep files you drop on the notch in the tray. If you're using DropNotch's Terminal tab, a command you ran there may be the one asking: commands there use DropNotch's access.
